name: Wheel of the Year
author: midnight
summary: Looks up the eight Wheel of the Year holidays, dates, types and modern observances; use for upcoming or recently passed Pagan holidays, Yule, Mabon and other seasonal festivals.

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Returns the eight seasonal holidays in calendar order for a hemisphere. Use the current local date from RIGHT NOW to identify upcoming, recent or current holidays; date comparison is yours. Solar date ranges are approximate, not exact annual dates. Default north; use south for a seasonally shifted Southern Hemisphere wheel.

hemisphere.description: Seasonal calendar to use: north or south. Follow the user's stated practice or location; if unknown use north and state that assumption.

tools.name: get_holiday
tools.description: Looks up one Wheel of the Year holiday: name, alternate names, dates for both hemispheres, Fire Festival or Solar Festival type, detailed theme and modern observances. Use after get_calendar identifies a nearby holiday, or for a question about a named holiday. Map Lammas to lughnasadh and Midsummer to litha.

holiday.description: Canonical holiday id. Map alternate names to the corresponding id: Lammas = lughnasadh, spring equinox = ostara, summer solstice = litha, autumn equinox = mabon, winter solstice = yule.
